clips.prompt: A surfer stands on a sailboard with knees bent and feet planted apart, left foot forward, balancing while gliding: small weight shifts from foot to foot, hips swaying slightly, arms held out to the sides for balance, looking straight ahead.

A surfer stands on a sailboard with knees bent and feet planted apart, left foot forward, leaning the whole body into a turn to the left: hips and shoulders tilted to the left, left arm lowered and right arm raised for balance, looking into the turn.

A surfer on a sailboard crouches low into a fast run, knees deeply bent and feet planted apart, left foot forward, torso leaning forward, arms tucked in and slightly out for balance, bracing against speed.
